analysis: Both changed files are test-only: SandboxSetupTests.swift (tail excerpt, lines 907-1107) and SandboxTestSupport.swift (new SandboxFixtures.ready(linux:macOS:jobsRunning:) helper at head lines 59-67). The helper does string replacement on a static fixture JSON and only builds test input. No production code, network, auth, attestation, key custody or cache paths are modified, so TB-013/T-061 (installer and add-on tampering) is not changed by this PR. The visible test tail covers installer failure exit status, stop-while-waiting texts, refusal before download (requests 0), too-small Mac stopping before install, confirmation gating (declined by default without a terminal, --yes required) and download failure messaging. These tests assert that behavior; they do not alter it. The fake installers run only in sandboxed temp roots against the stub CoordinatorStub with the sandbox.invalid host, so there is no real network exposure or secrets. The fixtures include only sample UUIDs and codes. The main patch for SandboxSetupTests.swift is truncated; its earlier hunks (free-space note tests, around lines 236-273 and 593-817 head) were not fully visible, so I could not review them. They are tests that assert the CLI's text output. No threat model gaps arise from the visible content. The production SandboxSetupFlow code that these tests exercise is not in this batch and should be reviewed separately for the confirmation and installer-run behavior in T-061.
